purpose: Small official-source Colorado locality supplement for gemstones/minerals underrepresented by MRDS. Reference points represent named localities or areas, not specimen pockets.

records.name: Mount Antero Aquamarine Locality
records.location_precision: Named Mount Antero reference point; mineral-bearing area is broader
records.source_note: CGS documents aquamarine (blue beryl) with smoky quartz in pegmatites on Mount Antero; access can be claimed/private.

records.name: Mount White Aquamarine Locality
records.location_precision: Named Mount White reference point; mineral-bearing area is broader
records.source_note: CGS identifies Mount Antero and Mount White as premier gem-quality aquamarine localities in pegmatitic granite.

records.name: Crystal Peak–Lake George Amazonite Locality
districts: Crystal Peak area near Lake George
records.location_precision: Crystal Peak area reference point; study locality is broader
records.source_note: USGS describes the Crystal Peak area near Lake George as world-renowned for amazonite (microcline) and smoky quartz.
